newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $961 mln in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $961 mln in Jan.

text.p: Brazil's commercial and financial foreign exchange transactions showed a preliminary surplus of $961 million in January in the forex commercial market, against a $3.262 billion surplus in December, bankers said.
Financial buy deals totalled $6.452 billion in January, according to Central Bank data supplied to banks. Financial sell operations amounted to $5.203 billion last month.
Dealers said January contracted exports were $4.305 billion against $4.593 billion in import operations.
